data.body:
**[P2] Finalize every started plugin before propagating a control exception**

`_dispatch_plugin` re-raises `KeyboardInterrupt`, `SystemExit`, and `GeneratorExit`, so an earlier plugin raising one from `on_invocation_end` aborts this loop. Later per-invocation plugins are then dropped without receiving their end hook: Insight can skip draining, while OTel can lose spans and leave context attached. For `InvocationEndInfo`, retain the first control exception, finish dispatching to `_started`, then re-raise it. Add a two-plugin regression.
